mapper.select: select u1.U_Name as drdHandlersName, mn.* from Design_Draw_Review_Dtl mn left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Drd_Handlers where mn.Dr_Id=#{id} order by mn.Drd_Sort ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Type as pType, u1.U_Name as drHandlersName, mn.* from Design_Draw_Review mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.Dr_Handlers where mn.id=#{id}
